# Stockroom Forecasting

## What you build

A forecast sheet, `forecast.csv`, with a demand estimate and a reorder date for every
item on the stockroom sheet from the first module.

## Topics this course must cover

- demand forecasting
- supplier lead times

## What you are assumed to bring

This course does not teach counting or reorder points. `tutorial.yaml` lists what it
assumes and how well; the placement check at the start of the course only asks about
what is new here.

## How this course teaches

- **You do the forecasting.** The tutor sets one task at a time and reads your sheet.
- **Start where you are.** The course starts from the state the first module left the
  stockroom sheet in.
- **Evidence, not assertion.** A lesson finishes when the sheet exists and you can
  explain how wrong the estimate is likely to be.

## The lessons

**00 - Setup.** Add the forecast sheet beside the stockroom sheet.

**01 - Placement.** A short check of the two new objectives.

**02 - Forecasting one item.** Estimate demand for one item and state the error.
